hypotheses.justification: The two uses of hB can be removed by replacing setIntegral_congr_ae with integral_congr_ae for the restricted measure. Both integrand equalities hold pointwise for every q, so the existing pointwise proofs work without any membership assumption. MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_image_emb and setIntegral_parabolic_to_product require no measurability of B. Thus the same integral identity and transfer of htrace hold for arbitrary B, including empty or nonmeasurable B, without integrability assumptions; the identity also holds at ε = 0.
